title: Elmira Stove Works — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Elmira Stove Works.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Canadian Heritage." Specialty tier. Elmira Stove Works, based in Elmira, Ontario, makes retro-styled ranges and appliances under the Heartland and Northland brands. Their antique-styled ranges have a devoted following in heritage and country kitchens across Canada.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Heritage kitchen designs, country homes, Canadian-made loyalists.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Elmira Stove Works:

• Canadian-made in Elmira, Ontario

• Antique styling with modern cooking technology

• Heritage and country kitchen specialist

• Unique offering that no other brand replicates

• Devoted customer following for decades
